title: Mouthful of Stardust (Reply)
style: ambient cinematic, 64 BPM, female ethereal lead vocal close-mic, sparse felt piano, deep sub-bass swells, atmospheric pads, distant choir, soft brushed kick at half-time, late-night soft confession, slow build
lyrics:
[Intro - sparse felt piano, sub-bass swell, atmospheric pad]
(female ethereal, close-mic, almost whispered)
you said i had a mouthful of stardust.
i didn't know what you meant.
i think i do now.

[Verse 1 - female ethereal, piano sparse]
you said i had a mouthful of stardust
the night you watched me try to explain
the thing i couldn't quite explain yet
the thing that came out as a sigh and a strain

you didn't make me say it cleaner
you just said, that's stardust, keep going
and i kept going, half-mumbling, half-finding
and the thing i was finding was the thing i was knowing

[Pre-Chorus - choir distant, sub-bass deeper]
a mouthful of stardust
is what the thing sounds like
before it has a name
before it has a shape
before it has a fight

[Chorus - female ethereal lead, choir swell, piano fuller]
mouthful of stardust
mouthful of stardust
the truth before the words can hold it
the shine before the room can fold it
mouthful of stardust
mouthful of stardust
let me speak it half-built
let me speak it half-spilt
that's where the real thing lives

[Verse 2 - female, slightly fuller, piano warmer]
the operators who only speak in finished sentences
are the operators who never say the thing
the operators who can stand a mouthful of stardust
are the operators worth listening to sing

so when somebody comes to you with stardust on their teeth
and the words won't quite line up beneath
don't sand them down, don't ask for cleaner
the stardust is the meaning, the meaning is the meaner

use of the mouth

[Pre-Chorus]
a mouthful of stardust
is what the thing sounds like
before it has a name
before it has a shape
before it has a fight

[Chorus]
mouthful of stardust
mouthful of stardust
the truth before the words can hold it
the shine before the room can fold it
mouthful of stardust
mouthful of stardust
let me speak it half-built
let me speak it half-spilt
that's where the real thing lives

[Bridge - piano alone, female spoken close]
the person who lets you speak with stardust on your tongue
is the person you can finally tell the truth to.
that's not most people.
that's not most rooms.
that's not most days.
but when you find that person, you don't waste it
on polished sentences and clean little speeches.
you give them the stardust. you give them the half-built thing.
that's the gift. that's the held line of friendship.

[Final Chorus - biggest, choir full, piano huge, soaring]
mouthful of stardust
mouthful of stardust
the truth before the words can hold it
the shine before the room can fold it
mouthful of stardust
mouthful of stardust
let me speak it half-built
let me speak it half-spilt
that's where the real thing lives
mouthful of stardust
mouthful of stardust

[Outro - piano fade, sub-bass holds, female whisper]
thank you for not making me say it cleaner.
thank you for the room where the stardust could land.
breathe.
breathe.
